name: speakeasy
description: Search and read your Speakeasy meeting transcripts and save summaries back. Runs locally from the installed Speakeasy app.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List saved meetings, newest first, with date, duration, speakers, tags and whether a summary exists. No transcript text. Filter by title words to find a meeting by name.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get one meeting's details, notes (summary, action items), tags, people and calendar event. No transcript: use get_transcript for that.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Full-text search across transcripts and notes. Returns ranked snippets (matches in **bold**) with the meeting id and time offset. Meeting titles aren't searched: use list_meetings with title.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read part of a meeting transcript as lines '[hh:mm:ss] Speaker: text'. Narrow with start_seconds/end_seconds; pass next_cursor as cursor to continue.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Calendar events (from the Mac's Calendar app, cached by Speakeasy) between two local days, with the ids of meetings recorded for them.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: All meeting tags with how many meetings use each.

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: People linked to meetings, with meeting counts.

tools.name: save_notes
tools.description: Save a meeting's summary, action items and/or tags. Only the fields you give are replaced; tags replace the meeting's whole tag list.
